title: WP-B0…WP-B3 of the BOAT build pack: policy and EST crash model, handwritten commands and offline synchronization, provisional RENAEST mapping and monthly tenant-scoped transmission job, consumer-owned projections, command contracts, and the Owner-approved Default D1 preliminary PDF/A-2b report

batches.headline: Delivered WP-B0/WP-B1: reconciled est:* policy, UC-BOAT-013, BP-EST-CRASH-001, DDL 19/70, generated EST crash package, fixtures, lifecycle vocabulary, purpose-audited victim reads, RLS and validation (PR #55).

Delivered WP-B2/WP-B3: handwritten crash commands and sync applier, provisional RENAEST mapping and mock integration, three consumer-owned projections, tenant-scoped monthly job, command contracts and clients, and the Default D1 preliminary PDF/A-2b report with STYNX storage/signature substrate and real veraPDF validation (PR #71).

delivery-review.detail: CTG-0001 reached PASS on restricted cycle 4. CTG-0002 document completion reached PASS on restricted cycle 3 after the Owner authorized remediation of six high and one low findings and temporarily authorized a Codex GPT-5.6 Sol reviewer while Claude was unavailable.

github-ci.detail: PR #55 run 35150065364 passed all five required jobs. PR #71 run 35526082301 passed backend-kernel, boat-documents-real, evidence-gate, foundation, senatran-mock and senatran-mock-tests.

repository-check.detail: The post-R-0013 integrated candidate passed pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and pnpm check, including format, generated blueprint/contract/parameter consistency, type integrity, RLS, lifecycle, SENATRAN boundaries, Portal 1314 pass plus 14 todo, and builds.

backend-and-database.detail: Shared 404/404, app unit 120/120, EST unit 1/1, full PostGIS apply, seed twice, app integration 19/19, app E2E 382 pass plus 2 pre-existing todo, remaining E2E packages green, and RAIT destructive upgrade rehearsal 18/18.

documents-real.detail: The isolated real tier passed 2/2 with Python 3.13.7, WeasyPrint 70.0 installed from a complete hashed lock, and the immutable veraPDF image. Production facade, SQL repository, STYNX storage, restart persistence and full validation evidence were exercised.

notes: D-1 binds the Owner-authorized R-0010 maestro execution for BOAT WP-B0…WP-B3. D-2 records the Architect closing judgment after both coupled groups reached delivery PASS, protected CI was green, and exact-SHA audit observation completed. Projection option 1, the monthly job boundaries, and Default D1 were Owner-approved. Official BAT status, its normative fields and production RENAEST homologation remain source_pending under DT-061/OD-B08; the preliminary report makes no official BAT claim.
